metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.identity_rule: Each review/appeal case has explicit identity.
semantics.decision_rule: Case references exact disputed governance decision.
semantics.evidence_rule: New and original evidence refs are exact.
semantics.history_rule: Original decision remains immutable history; new decision supersedes only through explicit relation.
semantics.authority_rule: Submitting appeal grants no protected-resource access.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.
